metadata.title: Golden Era Hip-Hop Album Cover Layout

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast layout featuring a sepia-toned photographic subject integrated into a field of repetitive textures, anchored by a heavy, multi-tiered typographic block in the upper left.
triggerTerms: sepia monochrome photography with red accent

recipe.visualDefinition: A sepia-toned photograph of two figures emerging from a flock of sheep, featuring a prominent three-tiered typographic lockup in the top-left corner using heavy slab serifs and a red horizontal bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Typographic block anchored to the top-left corner
Figures positioned centrally within a repetitive texture of sheep
High-contrast black and white text boxes against a sepia background
Red horizontal bar providing a singular color accent at the base of the text block
coreInvariants: Heavy slab-serif typeface for primary text
Inverted color boxing (white on black, black on white)
Red accent bar for secondary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures at medium-long shot, surrounded by sheep that fill the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, high-contrast 'BLACK SHEEP' typographic block in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text block, moves down to the figures, and then spreads across the texture of the sheep flock.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the flock and the large text block.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and White (Typographic boxes and figure clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the typographic elements.

treatment.fill: Inverted (Black on White / White on Black)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact slab serif for branding paired with a functional condensed sans-serif for titles.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif and blunt terminals.
Alternative for the condensed, heavy feel if slab serifs are unavailable.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned photograph of two men in dark clothing standing in a dense field of sheep. The sheep should fill the foreground and midground with a repetitive woolly texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a three-tiered typographic block in the top left. The top tier is a white box with a black border containing bold slab-serif text. The middle tier is a solid black box with white slab-serif text. The bottom tier is a solid red bar with small black sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the text block anchored to the top left?
Are the primary fonts heavy slab serifs?
Is there a red bar at the bottom of the text stack?

mustRedesign: Do not use thin or elegant serif fonts
Ensure the red is a flat, solid color

mustAchieve: Clear visual hierarchy between the text block and the photo

postGenerationChecks: Check that the top box has a visible black outline.
Verify the middle box is solid black with white text.
Ensure the red bar is perfectly horizontal and contains legible text.
Confirm the photographic subject is centered relative to the sheep flock.
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Photo + [Top-Left Boxed Slab Serif Stack] + [Red Accent Bar]
